Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production environment sprite atlas for La Horda, Arena Gélida.
Reference image: use ONLY the small pixel sprites on the RIGHT of the attached codex for pixel-cluster craft and dark outline, NOT the painted illustration or layout. Generate a brand-new TRANSPARENT square 1024x1024 sprite atlas, exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows of 256x256 cells, no grid or text. Sixteen independent objects, centered in their own cell, grounded at y=228 within every cell, 20 px empty margin, no overlap. Top-down three-quarter RPG environment sprites, premium 16-bit dark-fantasy pixel art, crisp deliberate 2-3 pixel clusters, hard alpha edges, limited palette, readable silhouettes, 3-4 stepped material shades. Real sprites, no painted backgrounds, NO ground tiles or drop shadows.
Row 1: (1) carved frozen standing stone pillar with ice spikes; (2) different asymmetrical cluster of tall ice shards; (3) layered snow-covered grey boulder; (4) shorter blue crystal cluster.
Row 2: (1) ancient frozen tree with twisted dark trunk and snowy blue branches; (2) second frost-covered conifer, dark blue needles and snow shelves; (3) frozen armored knight statue on a small stone plinth; (4) ancient broad stone portal ENTIRELY FILLED WITH SOLID ICE, no walkable hole, layered carved masonry, icicles.
Row 3: FOUR consecutive lit frames of ONE IDENTICAL iron-and-stone standing brazier, fixed pedestal, fixed bowl position and dimensions, flame dances left/up/right/up, orange amber cream angular fire, dark wrought iron supports, frost only on the pedestal. Keep the pedestal pixel-perfect in place.
Row 4: (1) THE SAME brazier extinguished: grey coals and no flame; (2) THE SAME brazier nearly exhausted: tiny ember and low orange flicker; (3) THE SAME brazier ignition: low flame catching; (4) THE SAME brazier ignition: flame rising. All eight brazier bases must have exactly the same architecture and foot alignment. Brazier occupies lower 150px of cell, flame can rise 60px. Ice objects vary naturally in width, never stretch.
No text, labels, UI, watermark, decorative frames, checkerboard, clouds, halos, blur or gradients. True transparent background.
